fields.label: Finish Item
fields.description: Manual entry - pick the same Finish Item used in the Finish Item table above.

fields.label: Yarn Rate
fields.description: = sum of the Raw Materials table's Cost for rows whose Article matches this row's Finish Item. Judgment call - flag if you meant something else by Yarn Rate.

fields.label: Wastage Amount
fields.description: = Yarn Rate x Wastage Total Percent / 100. Judgment call - flag if you meant a different base.

fields.label: Wastage Total Percent
fields.description: = this Finish Item's Dyeing Wastage % + Weaving Wastage % (from the Finish Item table above).

fields.label: Trims Charges
fields.description: = sum of the new Trims table's Amount for rows whose Finish Item matches this row.

fields.label: Total Cost
fields.description: = Yarn Rate + Dyeing Charges + Weaving Charges + Wastage Amount + Stitching Charges + Trims Charges.
